course_name_en: KMM4611 — Process Design in Chemical Engineering 1

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use mathematics, basic science, and engineering knowledge learned previously in chemical engineering education to perform any process design.
Ability to analyze and design a system and a process using modern techniques and tools, and to create, monitor, and evaluate chemical process flow diagrams.
Ability to conduct resource research related to a process and equipment, and to use databases and other information sources.
Ability to maintain individual and group work.
Ability to prepare technical reports and communicate in written and oral forms.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Process and Plant Design: Project Development, Role of the Chemical Engineer, Chemical Engineering Design
Chemical Process Flow Diagrams: Structure and Synthesis of Flow Diagrams
Chemical Process Flow Diagrams: Structure and Synthesis of Flow Diagrams; Tracing Chemical Substances through the Process Flow Diagram
Computer-Aided Design Project Work (Production Processes, Process Selection and Capacity Selection)
Mass and Energy Balances: Mass Balances; Applications
Mass and Energy Balances: Energy Balances – Applications
Design of Process Equipment: Reactors - Submission of Interim Report
Design of Process Equipment: Process Equipment for Fluid Transport
Design of Process Equipment: Heat Transfer Equipment; Computer-Aided Design Project Work
Design of Process Equipment: Heat Transfer Equipment
Design of Process Equipment: Mass Transfer Equipment
Design of Process Equipment: Mass Transfer Equipment
Submission of Project Report - Oral Presentation of Computer-Aided Design Project Report
Oral Presentation of Computer-Aided Design Project Report
